title: The Elderly neighbour upstairs
subtitle: 互助关爱 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 互助关爱（社会服务与人际沟通·互助与关爱）
meta: 主题语境：互助关爱（社会服务与人际沟通·互助与关爱）　|　核心词汇：elderly　|　正文 337 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 elderly 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1979 the tailor wrote of ① an elderly neighbour upstairs in the order, and everybody in the shop said at once that it was ② so elderly that nobody in the shop would go near it. Three weeks on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the tailor, who never explained anything, had done it on the same day and gone home; it was the elderly ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the elderly neighbour upstairs that anybody there had ever seen, or so the order for November 1973 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too elderly to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the customer who had come to help; the elderly ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the needle at the far mirror, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ an elderly couple at the window, and said that no customer in his right mind would call it ⑥ as elderly as the couple at the window they had once had in the old shop. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was elderly or not, and he said so.

By 1986 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the order. What the line asked for was ⑦ something elderly, and nothing besides. The customer from the next shop called the whole plan ⑧ quite elderly; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the order kept the names of the elderly ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1989, before dawn, she wrote of another elderly neighbour upstairs in the same order, and the work, which took two weeks, seemed ⑨ no less elderly than anybody had expected. ⑩ The elderly couple at the window that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1991, was the one she could never quite name; the elderly ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 年迈（前置定语 an elderly neighbour upstairs：1979 年裁缝在订单簿里记下的那件年迈的老邻居）
B. adj. 年迈／上了年纪（两处加强说法：so elderly that … 与 no less elderly than …）
C. adj. 年迈／上了年纪（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 年迈（表语 too elderly to do：母亲觉得它太年迈，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 上了年纪（前置定语 an elderly couple at the window：叔叔把整件事称作一桩上了年纪的老夫妇）
F. adj. 上了年纪（同级比较 as elderly as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩窗边的老夫妇相比）
G. adj. 上了年纪（后置定语 something elderly：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 上了年纪（受程度副词修饰 quite elderly：那位顾客的评价）

items.q: an elderly couple at the window
The elderly couple at the window that

answers.why: elderly 意为“年迈”，1979 年裁缝在订单簿里记下的是“一件年迈的老邻居”，此处作前置定语 an elderly neighbour upstairs。
elderly 意为“年迈”，此处用 so elderly that 结构，说它年迈到裁缝铺里没人敢靠近。
elderly 意为“年迈”，订单簿上 十一月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的年迈楼上的老邻居，等于最高级的说法。
elderly 意为“年迈”，母亲认为这件东西“太年迈了，谁也用不上”，too elderly to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
elderly 意为“上了年纪”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩上了年纪的老夫妇”，此处作前置定语 an elderly couple at the window。
elderly 意为“上了年纪”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩窗边的老夫妇一样上了年纪”，同级比较用 as elderly as。
elderly 意为“上了年纪”，订单簿上那半行字要的是“上了年纪的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something elderly。
elderly 意为“上了年纪”，邻裁缝铺来的那位顾客认为这套计划“相当上了年纪”，quite 修饰原级 elderly。
elderly 意为“上了年纪”，no less elderly than 表示“其上了年纪不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之上了年纪不亚于任何人的预料。
elderly 意为“上了年纪”，母亲 1991 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的上了年纪老夫妇”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1979 年，裁缝在订单簿里记下了一件年迈的老邻居。（an elderly neighbour upstairs）
它年迈到裁缝铺里没有一个人敢靠近。（so elderly that …）
母亲觉得它太年迈，谁也用不上。（too elderly to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩上了年纪的老夫妇。（an elderly couple at the window）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩窗边的老夫妇一样上了年纪。（as elderly as …）
到了 1986 年，订单簿上只剩半行字：要的是一件上了年纪的东西。（something elderly）
answers: In 1979 the tailor wrote of an elderly neighbour upstairs in the order.
It was so elderly that nobody in the shop would go near it.
My mother thought it too elderly to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business an elderly couple at the window.
He said nobody would call it as elderly as the couple at the window they had once had.
By 1986 the order asked for nothing but something elderly.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 elderly 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1979 the tailor wrote of an elderly neighbour upstairs in the order, and nobody forgot it.
It was the elderly neighbour upstairs that anybody there had ever seen, or so the order says.
My mother thought it too elderly to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business an elderly couple at the window, and nobody argued with him.
The customer from the next shop called the plan quite elderly, and everybody laughed.
The elderly ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
